run_plot_tsv: run plot.py on a TSV log file to generate a terminal plot of episode returns over steps
run_plot_csv_with_errorbars: run plot.py on a CSV file with the --errorbars flag to show error bars on the plot
run_plot_with_smoothing: run plot.py with --smoothing cumsum and --window 100 to apply cumulative sum smoothing to the data
run_plot_multiple_files: run plot.py with multiple glob patterns to overlay plots from several log files on one chart
run_plot_custom_dimensions: run plot.py with --width 120 and --height 40 to set custom terminal plot dimensions
